name: powerup
description: PowerUP: the disaster layer for a home-battery fleet. PowerUP plans for wildfire shutoffs; Interlock guards every order; neighborhood islands share batteries behind SCE's switches.

scripts.test: node --test interlock/tests/*.test.mjs pilot/app/tests/guard.test.mjs && node islands/island.test.cjs && node pilot/tests/pilot.test.cjs && node pilot/app/tests/smoke.cjs && node --test pilot/app/tests/scheduler.test.mjs
scripts.build: python3 -I pilot/build_data.py && python3 -I pilot/build.py && python3 -I pilot/app/build_pack.py && python3 -I pilot/app/build.py && python3 -I site.py
